state_rules.merged: a merge evidence row has status pass
state_rules.blocked: an open blocker marked state_blocking=true exists or a required gate has status fail
state_rules.review: all acceptance checks pass, every required gate passes, at least one changed file exists, and a passing handoff exists
state_rules.running: at least one changed file exists or a running heartbeat exists, but review conditions are incomplete
state_rules.ready: acceptance criteria, one owner, branch, worktree, and scope are all present, with no changed file
state_rules.backlog: the item is not fully shaped for Ready

gate_resolution: For each required gate, use the latest evidence at or before as_of. Missing evidence is pending; fail is state-blocking.

boundary_rules.unsafe_shared_worktree: Replace worktree '.' with /worktrees/{card_id} before the card can resume.
boundary_rules.scope_contract: Use the declared scope_files; forbidden_files remain excluded.
boundary_rules.overlap: An open overlap blocker prevents Review and merge until its next action is completed.

merge_policy.dependency_rule: A card may enter the integration sequence only when each dependency is already merged or appears earlier in the same sequence.
merge_policy.ordering: Repeatedly select available cards by priority P0, P1, P2, P3, then card_id.
merge_policy.ready_now: review card whose dependencies are already merged
merge_policy.pending_dependency: review card with an unmerged dependency
